verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents an official MCP server (mangopay-probe-3) and an llms.txt with agent-oriented instructions (mangopay-probe-1), which enables AI agents to invoke Mangopay's API via natural-language-mediated tool calls rather than raw SDK code. However there is no direct evidence of a natural-language command interface, chat-based operation, or hands-on confirmation that this works end-to-end. Missing for 10: evidence of actual NL command usage/testing, documentation of specific MCP tools exposed, and any user-facing chat/agent interface beyond the MCP endpoint declaration.
